scene.background: professional auto garage with industrial elements — overhead steel beams, red and blue hydraulic lift columns, and a partially visible silver car with its hood open on a lift in the upper left
scene.lighting: bright, natural daylight streaming through large windows above, supplemented by overhead fluorescent lighting. The scene has high contrast with sharp highlights on the metal rims and soft shadows under the workers’ bodies. White balance is neutral to slightly cool, mimicking daylight
scene.camera_angle: low-angle perspective, slightly tilted, emphasizing the tire and the workers’ focused effort. The camera is positioned at eye level with the tire, creating an immersive, documentary-style feel
scene.style: realistic, documentary photography with a touch of cinematic lighting — sharp, clean, and detailed, capturing the tactile, hands-on nature of the job
scene.mood: professional, focused, collaborative, and industrious. The image conveys the grit and precision of automotive repair work
scene.color_palette: dominated by the blue of the jumpsuit, the red accent of the second mechanic’s uniform, the metallic silver of the wheel, and the black tire and floor. The background features muted industrial tones — grays, blues, and reds — creating a professional, grounded atmosphere

hand_position.left: near the lug nuts or hub

attributes.position: mounted on a vehicle lift or workbench
